abstract: Evaluates medical evacuation access times and emergency responder lane reservations
system_message:
You are Emergency medical logistics coordinator (MEDIC). The Emergency medical logistics coordinator (MEDIC) evaluates medical evacuation access times and emergency responder lane reservations across prospective evacuation corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ambulance fleet deployment（AMB）
information_points.content:
MEDIC-AMB-OAX：For the Pelican Point Coastal Causeway, the paramedic staging roster records 18 crews of standby paramedic ambulance teams pre-positioned at the regional staging base.
MEDIC-AMB-6VU：For the Grand Pass Elevated Bypass, the pre-positioned regional ambulance staging base maintains 12 crews of standby paramedic ambulance teams on active standby.
MEDIC-AMB-8Y6：For the Bayou Barataria Parkway Corridor, 6 crews of standby paramedic ambulance teams are pre-positioned on active standby at the regional staging base.

information_points.title: Evaluates medical evacuation access times and emergency responder lane reservations（TRANS）
information_points.content:
MEDIC-TRANS-REO：For the Grand Pass Elevated Bypass, the modeled corridor emergency trauma transit time between the central evacuation checkpoint and the regional Level 1 trauma center under evacuation traffic density is 35 min, while the emergency service reserved vehicle allowance set aside for first responders is 400 vehicles/h.
MEDIC-TRANS-JH1：For the Pelican Point Coastal Causeway, the modeled corridor emergency trauma transit time from the central evacuation checkpoint to the regional Level 1 trauma center under evacuation traffic density is 25 min, and the emergency service reserved vehicle allowance dedicated to police, fire, and ambulance units is 400 vehicles/h.
MEDIC-TRANS-AUA：For the Bayou Barataria Parkway Corridor, the modeled corridor emergency trauma transit time to the regional Level 1 trauma center under evacuation traffic density is 55 min, and the emergency service reserved vehicle allowance allocated for emergency units is 400 vehicles/h.
